description: Parity gap found by Binary Handling (fz-9e2.3 work), filed under the user's standing direction to put Elixir parity gaps on fz-mue. A value whose inspection runs past 80 columns prints on one line in fz; Elixir's IO.inspect/inspect (Inspect.Algebra, default width: 80) breaks it across lines. Done: inspect/IO.inspect honor :width (default 80) and :pretty with Elixir's layout, matching Elixir byte for byte on an oracle fixture, on interp, run and build. Follows fz-sc8.10 (inspect with limit:). Owner: Elixir Parity.
title: IO.inspect wraps a long value at 80 columns, as Elixir's pretty printer does
